Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: Ops plan (planning phase 1): Checked inventory — GH IV=20 PPE=21; StM IV=20 PPE=21. Both hospitals already above safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8), so NO stabilization transfers needed this phase; sending stock now would just incur holding cost. No active alerts or deficit requests. I will hold inventory at the provisioner (IV=70, PPE=77) and stand by to top up immediately if either hospital reports a shortage or a scheduling failure. Department agents: schedule early and flag any bottleneck concern before scheduling Radiology/Ward steps.

Triage ops plan (phase 1, iter 1): Inventory at GH is safe (IV 20, PPE 21) — no top-up request needed this phase, so I will stay quiet on public channels to avoid over-supply/holding cost. My queue has 8 step-0 tasks, capacity 4. I will schedule my 4 highest-priority patients (Patient_1, Patient_3, Patient_4, Patient_2) at the earliest feasible slots, then handle the rest next phase. No transfers from GH. No failures expected — proceeding with scheduling directly, no gambling.
